What the heck is this about my beloved durdraw?

Is #76's QMP client the same lineage as Oligarchy's `src/qmp/client.ts`? Exercising #76 we hit three lifecycle holes: pending commands never reject when the socket closes, `stop()` waits forever if QEMU already exited, and connect retries continue after the child dies. Each has a failing test first. Want that as a commit on #76, against Oligarchy, or not at all? We haven't checked Oligarchy for the same holes.

(Found and tested with an AI agent; I reviewed it.)
